items.title: Casago Sold Nearly All Vacasa’s Property Manager Acquisitions and Turned Many Into Franchises
items.summary: It was quite a fall from grace for Vacasa, which as a private company in 2021 had a private valuation of $4.5 billion. Casago acquired it for less than $100 million, and now the last of Vacasa's remnants have been sold off.

items.title: Canadian Travel to the U.S. Is Rising Again — Still Down Almost 29% From 2024
items.summary: This "rebound" in Canadian travel to the U.S. only looks good next to last year's collapse.

items.title: Accor and IndiGo Launch Loyalty Exchange — Experiences and More Links Are Next
items.summary: The fact that it took Accor and IndiGo more than a year to roll out their loyalty partnership suggests there is a larger ambition to this than just swapping points.

items.title: When Hospitality Fails, The Problem Might Be the Guest
items.summary: The best hospitality is not a flawless one-way delivery. It is an exchange — and the guest has to bring attention, curiosity, and presence.

items.title: Ennismore Thinks Lifestyle Brands Can Survive All-Inclusive. Mondrian Is the Next Test
items.summary: Mass-market operators built all-inclusive on price and volume. Ennismore is trying to prove its lifestyle brands can carry the format upmarket.

items.title: What Haaland Mania Won’t Do for Norway Tourism
items.summary: Haaland mania is real. It will not move Norwegian tourism, and the visitors it might send are the ones Norway is already pricing out.

items.title: Hopper Settles With the FTC Over Practices Expedia Called Out in 2023
items.summary: Expedia ended its Hopper partnership in 2023 for 17 months over deceptive practices. Now the U.S. Federal Trade Commission, in another reputational hit, has reached largely the same verdict, with a $35 million price tag.

items.title: Booking Holdings Is Forming a New B2B Unit, Agoda CEO Is Overseeing it: Scoop
items.summary: Booking Holdings has an uphill climb to rival Expedia's scale in B2B, but the formation of a consolidated business unit could help Booking become a more formidable competitor.
